articleTitle: Human Attention Recognition with Machine Learning from Brain-EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Emotion recognition has always been a very popular field of research. Recently, EEG brain waves are used to recognize the emotional states of a person. Attention level also plays an important role in human life, but still demands more investigation. This paper proposes a noble human attention level recognition system using advanced machine learning algorithms. The system is cost-effective, single-channeled, and time-frequency scalp-EEG signals-based. In this study, the Bitalino EEG sensor board is used to record EEG signals from 30 human subjects in different attention states. Initially, the attention level was classified into three categories, which are focused, neutral and distracted. The data was taken while the subjects were watching interesting videos and boring lectures, doing simple and interesting math problems, and solving interesting and hard puzzles. At first, these EEG signals are pre-processed to remove noise such as muscle movement. Statistical coefficients (i.e. mean, standard deviation, skewness, kurtosis, and entropy) and statistical wavelet transform are used to extract meaningful features from the EEG signal. We mainly used two multi-scale wavelet packet statistics (WPS) and multi-scale wavelet packet energy statistics (WPES) to generate the feature vector. This feature vector was used to train the complex hybrid model with CNN and LSTM. This proposed method achieved almost 89% accuracy while determining the attention level of a subject.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Application to the Stroke Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Stroke is the cause of death and disability in the global population. Patients often suffer from strokes because poor living habits. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has become a hot topic in various fields, especially in medical applications. In this article, patient's physiological data is used to build model for predicting stroke in an artificial neural networks (ANNs). The ANNs method proposed in this paper can reach about 98% in classification accuracy under the condition of 1000 times cross-validation.

articleTitle: On Machine Learning Models for Heart Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have different architecture than regular Neural Networks (NNs) and are both applied extensively in many application fields. In this article, we used both of the two machine learning models in the heart disease diagnosis problems. We implemented the algorithms, tuned the parameters, and conducted a series of experiments. We aim to compare the prediction accuracy of the two models under different parameters settings. We used the Cleveland database which is took from UCI learning dataset repository for diagnosis heart disease. From the experimental results, we found that NNs outperform CNNs in prediction accuracy in most of the cases.

articleTitle: Environmental Monitoring and Smart Garbage Sorting System Based on LoRa Wireless Transmission Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Since the industrial revolution, scientific and technological advancements have made life more convenient and have facilitated the rapid growth of the global population. However, the amount of waste produced has also increased. Governments have invested a considerable amount of resources in solving this problem on waste source reduction and recycling. Accordingly, this study with a smart city concept developed a recyclable garbage sorting system that could be used in various locations to help eliminate littering in the city (from inconsistent waste disposal), diminish labor costs, and achieve the goals of increased recycling and reduced waste. This study integrated LoRaWAN communication networks (networks developed using the Internet of Things) with garbage sorting equipment to create a system that offers automated garbage can operation, environmental monitoring, and graphical interface monitoring. The system uses electrostatic capacitance-type proximity sensors to determine the types of garbage deposited in garbage cans. Furthermore, it contains an embedded motor and smart devices that can perform functions such as automatically opening and closing insertion points, sorting waste materials, initiating automated garbage compression, monitoring water levels, and issuing warnings when the water level exceeds the specified limit. This system employs a C# graphical monitoring interface to remind users to remove the garbage.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Diseases Prediction Using Artificial Neural Networks: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) are always been one of the diseases that cannot be ignored. Focusing on the field of preventive medicine related to CVD prediction, our preliminary literature has found about 891 related papers on artificial intelligence(AI), more than one-third adopted artificial neural network(ANN). As a result, this paper aims to provide such a survey of CVD prediction in ANN. After the completion of this survey, it's believed that a more effective and accurate CVD prediction system can be developed.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Artificial Neural Networks: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In order to remove the burden of heart disease (HD) physicians, recently more researchers have proposed to apply intelligent approaches, i.e., artificial intelligence to solve the HD prediction problem. According to our preliminary literature review of about 1685 related papers, it's found that, about one third of them were with ANN s. Therefore, this paper intends to provide an extensive survey of HD prediction for ANNs. When survey is completed, it's believed that the positive and effective research directions for intelligent HD prediction could be suggested and conducted.

articleTitle: A QoS Benchmark System for Telemedicine Communication Over 5G uRLLC and mMTC Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Among all wireless communication technologies, using 5G uRLLC and mMTC scenarios for telemedicine communication is the reasonable choice due to the quality assurance of its protocol design. However, determine the quality of medical-grade communication is still a huge task due to the cross-area knowledge integration and the cost of related research and development. In this paper, we propose a QoS benchmark system that can be used to verify the communication quality of the telemedicine system over 5G uRLLC and mMTC scenario in a good cost-efficiency. The results show the low cost and the good performance to benchmark the communication quality of a telemedicine system. The proposed QoS benchmark system can benchmark for two telemedicine scenarios, including the massive telemedicine medical device for health care and the multiple real-time online interactions for telesurgery.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Training System for Rehabilitation of Patients with Stroke Based on Compensatory Movement Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The application of virtual reality (VR) technology to medical care has become a key focus in recent years. We collaborated with a physiotherapy clinic to develop a crossdisciplinary technological system for assisting in homecare and health services for the elderly. The system in this study was mainly designed for patients who have suffered from stroke and to be used in medical care institutions for rehabilitation programs. Additionally, the same technology is applied to home-based rehabilitation for patients with dementia, Parkinson's disease, or chronic strokes. In addition to commercialization in the healthcare industry, the developed system also facilitates community and telehealth services for elderly individuals.

articleTitle: Research on Aromatherapy Relieving Anxiety of Menopausal Women and Introducing Artificial Intelligence and Robot Arms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: For current clinical studies, although hormone preparations are commonly used to cure menopausal symptoms, some risk of cancer can be brought in. Thus, supplementary or alternative therapies could be derived, in which the aromatherapy seems an option. The aim of the study is to examine whether essential oil massage can reduce the anxiety of menopausal women, thereby exploring the possibility of introducing artificial intelligence (AI) instead of manpower. Based on the State- Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI), the quasi-experimental design have been applied to examine the usefulness of aromatherapy massage for relieving anxiety. The results found, that after a three-month-intervention of aromatherapy massage by essential oils, the trait and the state anxiety all response significant decrease. However, the control group uninvolved in any intervention has shown a non-significant difference result. It can be suggested that aromatherapy can be a useful method to decrease the anxiety level of menopausal women's. Therefore, this study continues to explore the possibility of introducing artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the diagnosis of anxiety and to replace human massage with robotic arms.

articleTitle: Functional Deployment of Drone Logistics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In the era of the Internet, the logistics industry continues to grow. Only fast, convenient, modern and automated logistics distribution can match the growing logistics demand. Drone logistics has these unique characteristics, which provides advantages for drone logistics distribution. Amazon, Wal-Mart, Google and many other companies, such as UPS, Wal-Mart, 7-Eleven, and Domino have tested drones for delivering small packages or groceries, and they will probably become common in the near future. The high benefits brought by drones are visible, and play an important role in the distribution of “last mile” in far and traffic inconvenient areas. Although public perceives benefits from the use of drones to perform a variety of functions throughout society. It is also clear that drones are perceived as presenting risks to personal safety, public safety, and privacy. Therefore, drone delivery providers need to understand potential consumers' demands to adopt drone delivery. However, a systematic study to characterize the public's demand of drone logistics, or to identify its broader concerns, has yet to be undertaken. Therefore, this paper used KANO model to investigate the customers demand for drone logistics service from 23 indicators of six dimensions in terms of national regulations, technical security, technical equipment, the efficiency of drone logistics, risk prevention and audience preference constraints.

articleTitle: Analysis on Functional Demand of Mobile-Health APP for Elders
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: According to official Chinese survey data, the scale of China's mobile medical market reached 2.84 billion Yuan in 2014. It is expected that by the end of 2020, the scale will exceed 10 billion Yuan. The country attaches great importance to the mobile medical market and large-scale capital investment, and chronic disease patients will be the biggest beneficiary group. At present, there are many Mobile- Health (M-Health) APPs in China, but most of their functions are simple, and their usability and maturity are still lacking. Therefore, this paper mainly uses the questionnaire survey and utilizes the KANO model to analyze the elders' requirements of Zhangzhou district in China for M-Health APP's function. In addition to identifying the Must and One-dimensional M-Health APP elements, the results of this study also found that customization and personalization features will be favored by the elderly. If M-Health application developers can provide these functions that delight to old people, they not only attract new consumers, but also consolidate loyal consumer groups and enhance the use of M-Health apps.

articleTitle: Utilizing UAV for 3D Map for Urban Land Use in Tainan City, Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The progress of science and technology has changed the way of topographic mappingwhich is no longer limited to traditional ground and aerial photogrammetry. Unmanned ariel vechicle (UAV) is used to create image maps, light-probing maps, measurement vehicle scans as a new state of the art technology. Drone flight tests are different from traditional large aircraft aerial measurements. Drones are not affected by climate much and does not cause any casualty with good safety, low-altitude operation, obtaining high-precision images. They have wider building coverage. Using drones increases the multi-faceted texture image of buildings with enhaced scale up to 1:1000. The images from drones avoids cloud cover with low cost, easy operation and maintenance. Mapping is very important in geography, architecture and other fields, especially in urban planning. Thus, we combine UAV technology with urban planning to build a three-dimensional (3D) model from the original two-dimensional (2D) plane of the urban planning and economic zone. Geographic Information Systems (GIS) is also used for urban planning to facilitate subsequent application and treatment.

articleTitle: Determinants Analysis of the Carbon Trading Market
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The study aims to use a scientific approach to investigate the pilot project of carbon trading market in Fujian of China from 2017 to 2019. The Grey Relative Degree Theory was used to analyze influence factors from four dimensions and nine index. The results of the study show that the pilot project of carbon trading price influenced by four dimensions respectively national income GDP, finance, afforestation carbon and energy emissions. After data calculation, the correlation ranking of each indicator is obtained, the most key factors related to city national and stock and fund transactions. But the ranking lower are respectively chopped wood, afforestation, total energy consumption. According to research results, three suggestions in terms of carbon finance development, legislation of carbon emission release and professional staff training are provided.

articleTitle: A Summary of Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality and Mixed Reality Technologies in Film and Television Creative Industries
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Virtual reality and augmented reality technologies have been applied to scientific research for many years and the achievements are remarkable. Although the application area of mixed reality is relatively narrow comparing to the first two applications, we have initially seen results. However, in fact, these technologies can be applied in film and television creation far more than that. I then illustrate some other aspects which these realistic contents can also be applied to in film and television creation in the future and the influence on the industry.

articleTitle: Applying Linguistic VIKOR and Entropy to Evaluate Competitive Ability of Medical Tourism in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Tourism is a high profit and low-cost industry. Medical tourism is one kind of tourism type. This kind of tourism type is high threshold and can bring more profit for government. However, a few of literatures research about competitive ability of medical tourism. This study collects relative literature and interview some expert to design the criteria to evaluate competitive ability of medical tourism. And then, linguistic VIKOR and Entropy are used to evaluate competitive ability of medical tourism among China, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea.

articleTitle: Artificial-Neural-Network-Based Consumer Behavior Prediction: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, consumers can understand the differences between products and advertising effects. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) is currently a hot topic in various fields, so many papers use artificial neural networks (ANN) in consumer behavior prediction (CBP). This paper will compare the differences between AI and statistical systems. It's believe that in the near future, this survey will be useful for systems using AI for CBP.

articleTitle: Maximizing Social Influence in Nearly Optimal Time: SRIS model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The influence maximization problem (IMP) is defined to select the node group with the maximum propagation range from the social network through using an information propagation model. However, the existing influence maximization algorithm is unfitting for large size networks because of the high time complexity. A SRIS algorithm based on reverse reachable set is proposed, greatly improves the running time efficiency without compromising its asymptotic performance. Finally, the experiment simulation results indicated that SRIS model was more suitable for large-scale social networks.

articleTitle: Research on Face Image Morphing Based on Automatic Feature Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Image morphing refers to the technology that can realize the transformation of the source digital image to the target digital image in a smooth transition way. Among them, the most representative is to deform the human face. This paper implements a morphing method based on the Dlib library for automatic detection of facial feature points, including automatic feature detection, warp image and generalized morphing. This method can automatically calibrate the key points of the face more accurately, and use the Delaunay triangulation mesh deformation algorithm to achieve face image morphing. Experiments on multiple pairs of images prove the effectiveness and feasibility of the method.

Author Keywords: automatic feature detection and mesh deformation

articleTitle: Research on Robustness of Coupling Networks Based on Multi-subnet Composite Complex Network Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In order to solve the cascading failure problem of real networks, it is important to study the robustness of coupled networks. In this paper, a multi-subnet complex complex network model is used to build a cascading failure model on the coupled network. The influence of network size, adjustable parameters, and coupling factors on the robustness of the coupled network is mainly studied. Research shows that when both subnets are BA networks, the greater the contribution of the coupling relationship to the initial load of the nodes, and adopt heterogeneous coupling, networks will more robust.

articleTitle: Usability in the app Interface Designing for the Elderly with Low-Vision in Taiwan and Thailand
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Changing in vision is the process of progressive disability with age. Nevertheless, the visual symptoms do restrain them from being independent. Under the concept of active aging, it is very essential to allow the elderly to maintain their independent ability in their daily living. The objective of this research is to develop an application (the app) for seniors to measure their low vision status autonomously through smart devices in their places. In this research, literature reviewing and investigation from various eyes' symptoms (such as macular degeneration, glaucoma and so on) were carried out to develop the interface mechanism that act as a simulation tool for measuring elders' visual capabilities and ocular condition. Based on these, the visual interface design with visual field simulation tools were suggested to obtain parameters for colorblind, and light and shadow control. Lastly, a prototype was developed through experiencing and interviewing both Thai and Taiwanese to gain the better understanding of the seniors' needs and usability. The results provide an alternative option for the elderly staying at home while keeping their vision health status instead of unnecessary visiting hospital in person.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Based Indoor Localization Using WLAN Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The paper introduces a method and system for real-time positioning of mobile terminals in indoor areas. The system uses wireless LAN infrastructure (usually Wi-Fi) and evaluates signal strength from different access points. The system meets requirements and has been implemented in Java for Android-based mobile devices and successfully tested at the Centre for Assistive Technologies (CAT) at the Czech Technical University in Prague, Faculty of Electrical Engineering. The results demonstrate an average accuracy of approximately 2.5 m, which is satisfactory for determining the position of a client device at room-level (e.g. in hospitals for checking whether a patient or staff member is currently in an expected place or for deciding where they can be assigned). Its potential applications are in healthcare, disaster management, supervision of people with disabilities, etc., but also in monitoring staff and goods in closed areas.

articleTitle: A Study on Public Acceptability of Traditional Chinese Medicine Meridian Instruments
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In view of TCM Meridians' philosophy, this research advocates that human meridians and organs are the unit of the body; on the basis of the integration analysis from application and combination of Bio Electricity and Conscious Energy, as well as the energy adjustment to promote physical and mental balance apart from creative thinking, this model of integration methodology is constructed with an eye to promoting the balanced and sound development on civil personalities. Furthermore, it is the application of this project that clarify the theory foundation from TCM Meridians, inclusive of adopting civil back and forth situation analysis made by the energy adjustment, utilizing the energetic therapy through A.I. medical equipment, detecting the distribution of meridian energy in human bodies, comprehending if the subject has a well physical condition, and then fixing the way how to let individual body's meridian energy return to normal range after applying to the energy adjustment; on the top of that, this research will present the concept and model to conduct analyses by means of quantified data. Consequently, the operating process from statistical analysis out of each different variable is to reach for the correlation between the Chi-square value and the variable, what is more significant, to clarify public acceptability of TCM Meridian instruments.

articleTitle: Smart City Governance: Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Smart city is an important strategy for new urbanization and informatization. It has become an urgent agenda to build a complete evaluation system and realistic construction goals of a smart city. We researched relevant literatures about smart cities and summarized the research results of smart city evaluation system, which forms the theoretical basis of this study. To verify the importance of creating an evaluation system, the Fuzzy Delphi Method (FDM) is used. We analyzed the smart city evaluation system with consensus results of experts and scholars are obtained. The results can be used as an important reference for the smart city governance in the era of artificial intelligence (AI).

articleTitle: Matrix Decomposition Recommendation Algorithm Based on Multiple Social Relationships
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: A real society has multiple social relationships between users, but existing social network recommendation algorithms often only introduce a social relationship into the recommendation system. This paper introduces a variety of social relationships into the recommendation system based on a multi-subnet composite complex network model. Based on the analysis of the experimental results on the Epinions dataset, a recommendation algorithm introducing multiple social relationships has a significantly higher recommendation accuracy than a recommendation algorithm.

articleTitle: A Study on Species Identification Based on Leaf Contours of Taiwan Lauraceae and Fagaceae Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In this paper, a leaf species identification platform for Taiwan Lauraceae and Fagaceae plants is developed by using a variety of morphological features of leaf shape in combination with fuzzy theory and template matching technology. Firstly, the binary leaf contour is extracted by normalized sampling of leaf length and width through image preprocessing, and then the special geometric features of leaves, such as morphological convex hull, centroid-contour distance and serrated shape segmentation, are extracted respectively. Finally, the sample feature trainings and template comparison are carried out by fuzzy theory to judge the species identification of leaves. In this study, 54 species of mixed Lauraceae and Fagaceae were used to analyze the effect of leaf identification by the well-known algorithm k-NN and a method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A Research on Relevance Between Photoplethysmography Signal and External Stimuli
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In this paper, we mainly discussed the Photoplethysmography (PPG) response states of human beings under various stimuli. The Pulse Oximeter is used to obtain the PPG signals under different environmental stimuli. When we get the PPG signal, we send the packet to the server for time and frequency domain analysis by the ESP8266 wireless controller. There are 7 males and 5 females with a total of 12 subjects and average age is 22 years old. The experiment was conducted under the same environment and different stimuli, and was divided into eight environmental testing modes. The PPG signal response of the subjects can be detected by the different environment created by light, visual and auditory stimuli. The results show that different stimuli also have a direct impact on the PPG response of the subjects. The short-time Fourier transform analysis shows that different stimulus environments have a direct impact on the subjects' psychology, and these effects will also directly respond to the data of autonomic nervous system at the back end. The data obtained under various stimuli are directly compared and measured from physiological signals. It can establish an objective judgment of the patient's current mood, which can be used to explore the patient's diagnostic status in the process of diagnosis. In the long run, there will be more and more long-distance diagnoses and treatments in the future, and there will be more and more uncertainties. Therefore, it is necessary to assess the emotional status of patients in order to assess whether the physiological signals measured by patients are normal.

articleTitle: Privacy on Medical Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With the arrival of the artificial intelligence era, privacy disputes over the use of personal data derived from big data have appeared in greater numbers of instances. This paper explores the applications of artificial intelligence and big data to the medical industry, compares the differences in criteria and regulations for the identification of medical-use de-identified data between foreign and Taiwan practices, and further investigates the risks in using personal data, expecting that future legislation and practices in Taiwan provide better protection to the public for technology applications.

articleTitle: Development of Software Interface for Transfer of Patient Medication Preparation from Czech DASTA Standard to International HL7 Standard
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The safety of the drug delivery process increases with the introduction of new technologies and innovative approaches. The current safest and most effective practice is the automated preparation of drug therapies for individual patients centralized in a hospital pharmacy using robotically prepared single-dose drugs. Based on the performed analyzes, a combination of robotics for the preparation of single dose packages of drugs with one of the automated warehouses was recommended. Swisslog's combination of robotic technology meets this requirement. The paper describes the proposed technological-process change, defines the technical parameters and requirements of the system and identifies the requirements for IS/IT and NIS/LIS, respectively communication interface to the software solution of the central automated preparation of medicines Swisslog PillPick System and Swisslog BoxPicker so that the set can work in Czech hospitals. The paper deals with the creation of a SW interface that converts data necessary for robotic preparation of patient medication from the Czech DASTA data standard to the HL7 international standard used by selected robotics.

articleTitle: A Computational Model Refinement for Visibility Graph Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In recent years, space syntax is becoming a popular research tool in analyzing the human-space relationship in buildings and outdoor space. In this paper, we proposed a computational model refinement for Visibility Graph Analysis (VGA) in space syntax with a visual distance parameter that can be adjusted. An automatic computation prototype of VGA with dynamic visual distance was created. Several floor plans of real buildings were used to test our prototype. The results indicated that the dynamic visual distance can be more realistic for the model compared to the original model with infinite visual distance.

articleTitle: A Study on the Intention to Use the Online Face Mask Ordering System - An Application of Network Psychometrics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In December 2019, the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic emerged in Wuhan city, China and it quickly spread to across the world. Many experts suggest that wearing medical masks is a good protection against this disease. To help citizens obtain face masks, Taiwanese government instituted a name-based mask rationing system. This study intends to construct a research model which based on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) in the context of using the face mask ordering system to buy face masks. The research factors in the study include measurements of perceived usefulness of online face mask ordering system, perceived ease of use of online face mask ordering system, and the users' behavioral intention to use online face mask ordering system. Responses from a total of 120 users of the face mask ordering system were collected. After all, this study has identified important factors in perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use of this mask distribution system. It may provide the Minister of Health with implications for factors in users' intention to use this system. Understanding these factors may help the government increase users' willingness to use this online service when buying face masks.

articleTitle: Implement an IOT Platform of Biosignal Monitoring for Nurse Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: To enhance up the processing of biosignal monitoring in clinic, the main purpose of this study is focused to implement three Raspberry pi 3B embedded systems become as a biosig-nal monitoring platform. The developed microsystem will acquire and decode the physiological parameters (including ECG, BP, SPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, TP and RP) from SY-3000 module based on a Raspberry pi 3B embedded system. Then the embedded system will translate the data to the designed website homepage and backup on another cloud-based Raspberry pi 3B through the TCP/IP or Wifi as user's required. The designed platform are based on the integrated operation system among Linux, QT and MQTT. Finally, the families of the patient or the nurses can observe the physiological condition and biosignal trend through any mobile devices at anytime and anywhere. In addition, the VoIP and TLS/SSL techniques are also utilized in this platform to improve the voice communication ability and the cyber security in practice.

articleTitle: An Electronic Fence Application in in Mass Rapid Transit Station Scenarios with the Edge-Computing Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This study aims to detect personnel intrusion and personnel classification with a machine vision approach. In the public domain, how to provide a safe environment and convenient services is a topic of great concern to the government, police units and the public. In the past, in the management of intrusion detection on the periphery of the plant area, approaches with constructing infrared sensing and embedding wire to sense the passage of objects have been adopted. Apart from the problem of high construction cost, the hardly distinguishing people, animals or objects often happens. In this study, through image analysis with edge-computing way, the VPU (Video Processing Unit) in NVR (Networks Digital Video Recorder) combined with a machine learning approach is designed to set a virtual no-entry area in the MRT (Mass Rapid Transit) station. When someone enters the no-entry area, the image of person is marked and counted. The results show that the accuracy rate is 90.81% in terms of personnel entering the no-entry area. The main errors occur in personnel duplication marks and multiple duplication marks. In terms of personnel classification, the accuracy rate is 91.32%, and the main errors occur in similar wearing personnel.

articleTitle: EEG and ECG in Reducing Smartphone Overuse by Multiple Leisure Activities
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The major purpose is to develop the balanced patterns of leisure activity participation to solve the problem of smart phone overuse. For this, physiological indices from electroencephalograph (EEG) and electrocardiograph (ECG) and data from self-reported questionnaires were collected. As a result, multiple leisure activities have the potential for diversion from smart phone use. The results also showed that basketball games and calligraphy experiences might decrease smart phone overuse.

articleTitle: Exploring Entrepreneurs' Trust in Mobile Social Networking Services
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In information technology (IT) research, the concept of trust has been a critical characteristic of user behavior. In addition, previous studies on online social networking have discussed usefulness, ease of use, social influence, privacy concerns, and risk as the major determinants of trust. With regard to trends in online ventures, few studies have focused on entrepreneurs' trust within the contexts of social networking services (SNSs). By building on recent research on trust in information systems (IS) related to SNSs, the present study examines Facebook and evaluates its influence on online entrepreneurs' trust. This study also advances a model regarding the performance expectancy of mobile Facebook Mentions (PEMFM), effort expectancy of mobile Facebook Mentions (EEMFM), social interaction (SI), privacy concerns on Facebook (PCF), perceived risk of online social activities (PROSA), and online entrepreneurs' trust in Facebook (OETF) by conducting interviews with domain experts. The findings indicate that PEMFM, EEMFM, SI, and PROSA determine online entrepreneurs' trust. Moreover, the results show that SI plays an important moderating role among PEMFM, EEMFM, and OETF.

articleTitle: The Concept of Sustainability Integrated into the Interactive Shadow Play Interactive Learning System Design
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Taiwan's shadow play has a long history, and it belongs to Chaozhou Shadow system. The performance mode is to extend the other side of the plane with two poles and basic movements. Therefore, hand operation skills and coherence of shadow action are more important when operating. Today, this traditional culture is difficult to develop due to the impact of the sound and light effects of science and technology, the aging of traditional technicians and the impact of young people's leave. Therefore, the sustainable development of the value of traditional culture is one of the important issues of the government. Interactive technology is constantly innovating. The convenience of the Internet also breaks the geographical and time constraints. Combine the unique performance form and interactive technology of shadow play, the shadow puppets will be derived from different performance modes for learning and inheritance. This study analyzes the five basic actions of the shadow puppets and uses leap motion hand gesture recognition technology for interactive design. The digital experience teaching content is designed on the basis of applying the concept of sustainable development, experience learning and experience game theory, and hope to provide reference for future related traditional culture digital textbook design combined with sustainable development related papers.

articleTitle: Analytic Hierarchy Process to Establish Criteria for Design Planning of Historical Sites
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Historical relics reflect traditional features and local characteristics during a certain historical period and were the concentrated embodiment of a city's cultural heritage. Historical relics which are preserved with a good plan bring large economic, social and ecological benefits to the city, so they have drawn more attention in recent years. In spite of this, there are many problems in development and protection of historical relics. Top priorities are put on how to coordinate the needs of different groups of people, to retain the authenticity of historical relics, and to make them rejuvenated. In this paper, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) was used to divide elements related to the planning of historical relics into different levels. Based on this, a quantitative and qualitative analysis is conducted to establish criteria to preserve historical relics.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Multi-Functional Complex Network Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Different from previous complex network models based on graph theory, multi-functional complex network model (MFCN) only uses nodes to represent, and the content of graph theory is no longer applicable in it. In order to better apply MFCN, the storage structure, construction algorithm and traversal algorithm are defined and verified in the paper. The advantages of MFCN over the previous complex network models in constructing network are discussed.

articleTitle: The Development of a Life-saving Intelligent Clothing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: An intelligent piece of clothing with mobile transmission function (use of Internet of Things, IoT) was successfully developed and put into production. One of the major characteristics associated with this product is that it contains a micro-chip which is well arranged within the clothing fibers and will transmit six types of abnormal vibration signals from a human heart to a health cloud information center. A health supervisor monitors the abnormal heart vibration signals via the help of an app(application) that was developed for the use of intelligent clothing. In the current stage, the app was designed to be used by five health supervisors who can be the family members of an intelligent clothing user or a worker of a healthcare organization. As soon as one of these five health supervisors receives an abnormal signal from the health cloud, a rescue process will be activated if the heart vibration signal is life-threatening. Since the heart vibration information is saved in the health cloud, a medical care institution may retrieve the information instantly, in order to perform a life-saving rescue process which will have a higher chance of saving a patient, especially an older patient.

articleTitle: Possibility of Procedure Automation in Extracting Potential User Needs for New Product Design
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In order to respond to rapidly changing market needs, the manufacturing industry must develop investments based on latent needs. Moreover, use of the Internet of Things (IoT) provides an opportunity to drive the creation of new value and to spark innovation. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to automate the derivation of the latent needs of users using prototypes via IoT in the development of new products. To that end, we first describe the conventional process. Next, we describe the process of the new automation system. Lastly, we compare the previous two, and considered the advantages and disadvantages of automation. The results have revealed a feasibility study for implementing the automated derivation of latent needs among prototype users. Furthermore, the results have shown that the number of persons surveyed increased and quality-assured latent needs were rapidly derived.

articleTitle: Auto-ID Technology and the Internet of Things to Enhance the Quality of Health Services U-Health Concept
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Health care facilities are subject to high demands on the optimization of the management of medicines and medicaments, resulting inter alia from the requirements of the Joint Accreditation Commission. These demands depend primarily on the quality of the personnel and the ability to prevent errors due to human factors. By meeting these requirements and adhering to them, healthcare facilities will achieve accreditation of the quality of care provided. The whole concept is based on utilization of Auto-ID and Internet of Things technology which brings new opportunities for healthcare sector. To ensure a high standard of care with U-Health concept, we developed e.g. new type of bed that respect the concept of Auto-ID and IoT. This type of bed is equipped with a newly developed intelligent mattress with integrated sensor of surface loading, which enables timely preventive warning when the change of the position is needed.

articleTitle: Implementation of AQI Notification System Based on DVR and IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This study uses common gas sensor to monitor for space hazard gases. At the same time, it combines the image information and publics the information in network open platform. In the open platform, users can see obviously and obtain data related to diverse environments in the meantime, including air quality index, temperature, humidity, PM2.5 index and so on. In addition, we combine with the DVR system in the open platform. The display aspect of the platform not only gets implemented through the webpage to demonstrate the characteristics of cross-platform, but also develop mobile APP to push notifications on the phone. In this way the project can be improved. In addition to passively providing relevant data, it can also proactively send the alert messages. In terms of hardware devices, we use the environmental data measurement module to carry wireless Wi-Fi modules. We use SHARP GP2Y1014AU PM2.5 air quality sensor with DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor. After integrating with the Node MCU to read the sensed value, it sends the packet through Wi-Fi, and transfer the device's numerical information to the database through ESP8266. Finally, the information gets disclosed to network open platform, and pushed notifications to users that have registered account and installed APP. In terms of software, we write the programs that read the sensor values and send the packets through the Arduino IDE, and these packets will be transferred to the Microsoft SQL Server database. Lastly, we build a network platform through the ASP.Net of Microsoft Visual Studio. Meantime, we use Android Studio to write the mobile APP. The information will be announced and pushed in multiple ways. The network architecture uses the local area network (LAN) to transmit data. The monitored messages are transmitted to the cloud, and then announce the messages through the background program. In the design of the field, we use the tree topology. The tree topology is a hierarchical centralized control network. Compare to the topology, the communication line of tree topology is short and low cost, and the search path is convenient and easy to expand.

articleTitle: Study on Electronic Countermeasure of Notebook Computer HD Multimedia Interface for Electro-Magnetic Interference
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Standard selection procedure for electronic countermeasures is put forward in this essay based on practical cases, in which APREL EM-ISight near-field detecting instrument is equipped to analyze the field-intensity distribution of near-field electromagnetic noise so as to have a clear understanding of the differences between the electronic countermeasures.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Assists Novice Designer to Improve Problem-Solving Ability of Interior Floor Plan
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore how the artificial intelligence system of floor plan assist novice designer to improve problem-solving ability of interior floor plan. Through two experiments of drawing floor plan before and after, we used the method of document analysis to compare the differences of two drawings. Novices drew a floor plan of bedroom in first stage, and next, novices operated the artificial system of interior floor plan to construct their knowledge and learned various possible schemes in a short period of time. Finally, novices drew second floor plan of bedroom again. The result shows that the second floor plan to be improved significantly after novices used the intelligence system of floor plan.

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Controller for Improved Transient Performance of SEIG-based Wave Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This study presented the devise of a novel intelligent controller (NIC) for the stability of self-excited induction generator (SEIG)-based wells turbine. The proposed NIC consisted of a recurrent wavelet based Elman neural network (RWENN) and modified ant colony optimization (MACO). A MACO method is used to regulate the learning rates and enhance the learning capability of RWENN. The intelligent control strategy is realized to preserve balance between generator output and grid power, to maintain the constant voltage of alternating current line, and DC-Link stable during variable load and speed. The innovative control strategy in this study improves the power regulation and dynamic capability of wave energy in a large range of working status.

Author Keywords: Recurrent Wavelet based Elman Neural Network

articleTitle: Medical Web-Based Role Play Enhances Teaching of Medical Terms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This paper examines how an animated medical website can be used for learning. The website lists four categories: doctors, nurses, pharmacists and general medical staff. The animation is visually interesting and understandable for all levels of learner, including beginners. This paper subsequently studies participants' perspectives of the medical website regarding certain features such as on-screen explanations, the display of the animation and the design of the exercises. Based on learners' comments, examples of lesson plans, indicating how medical website-inspired instructions can help students, are discussed.

articleTitle: Study of an Integrated Intelligent System for Building Windows and Vehicle Management of Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With the advancement of radio frequency identification, wireless sensor networks, middleware, cloud computing and related applied software, the internet of things has been widely applied to agriculture, industry, fishing industry and logistics. Application of internet of things has changed the operation modes of respective industries tremendously. For example, the internet of things with a wide variety of sensors and actuators has facilitated plant management and assembly line processing. As a consequence, the applications of industrial internet of things have become more and more popular. The main function of industrial internet of things is plant intelligence. By referring to literatures related to the control system of intelligent windows, multi-function solar protection devices, cloud intelligent window opening-closing mechanism and several practical examples using industrial internet of things. This study designs an intelligent system integrating vehicle entry-exit and window management functions. This research aims to investigate how to apply integrated industrial internet of things to plant management intelligence.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of the Advanced Clinical System for the Treatment of Patients with Vitreous Floaters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Recently, vitreous floaters have increased due to aging or excessive use of eyes to read information and communications. Vitreous floaters by diseases can cause blindness. Therefore, this paper is to conduct an experimental analysis of the advanced clinical system for the treatment of vitreous floaters. The data were collected from May 10 to July 5, 2019 through surveys and interviews. The study surveyed 208 patients visiting department of ophthalmology at a general hospital in Korea. This paper analyzed the condition of the vitreous floaters and vision ability using t-test before and after the application of the clinical system over time. The results of the paper are as follows: the vitreous floaters have improved significantly since the application of the clinical system to the accupressure around the eye (t=-5.16, p<; .01) and decreased after 20 days of system compared to before system application. In conclusion, we believe that this study contributes to applying the treatment to other ophthalmic diseases effectively.

articleTitle: Application of UHF RFID Technology for Identification of Closely Spaced Medical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The global healthcare industry is transforming very quickly. For many years, healthcare providers have been addressing how to reduce errors that increase costs, lower quality of life for patients, and in a number of cases, have caused patient death. The paper discusses options for automated identification based on UHF RFID technology on stacked or very near objects, especially for use in healthcare. When using UHF RFID on closely spaced objects, such as test tubes, a particular problem arises. When two common UHF tag antennas are placed very near and parallel to each other, the structure becomes very similar to a folded dipole antenna. A solution based on testing the use of UHF RFID technology to identify medical test tubes is proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Prediction of LME lead spot price by neural network and NARX model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This paper presents a system for predicting the current price of lead based on artificial neural networks and NARX models. Using the London Metal Exchange (LME) spot metal price dataset for about 30 years, the proposed smart lead price prediction system can achieve prediction error of less than 10% (that's, approximately equal to $100). This article believes that in the near future, it can be expanded to predict futures prices from lead to other industries and even precious metals.

articleTitle: Construction of Evaluation System of Smart Living Space for the Elderly Based on Analytic Network Process
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This study constructs an evaluation system for a smart living space for the elderly using analytic network process (ANP). Through reference studies, we established six indexes to assess the smart living space. Responses from a survey with questionnaires were analyzed to obtain pairwise comparison results. The results showed that humanization degree is the most important factor to consider for better design for the smart living space for the elderly. Then, technological support and use of the technology are significant, too. This study suggests that a smart living space for the elderly have human-friendly environment with proper technologies. We expect the research result to provide a reference for the subsequent evaluation and design of a smart living space for elderly.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Implementation on BLDCM Commutation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: One way to do the commutation process at BLDCM is the six-step method. And hardware implementation for this method can be done in various ways. This paper will try to run a BLDCM commutation process using machine learning. Machine learning is an artificial intelligence method that can respond based on the learning process that was carried out previously through existing data sets. In this study, the training process is done offline. Then the “weight” obtained from the training is used in the Machine Learning structure which is implemented on the F28069M microcontroller. From the hardware implementation, it is proven that Machine Learning can be used in the BLDC motor commutation process.

articleTitle: Survey of Forex Price Forecasting Approaches based on Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In the era of global economic integration, currencies are used for various transactions, and different currencies need to be converted. Different exchange rates will be generated in different countries during the conversion process. Different exchange differences are generated, so a method can be used to FPP, so the purpose of this article is to consolidate related papers using artificial neural networks (ANNs) in AI, and analyze the MSE, MAE, etc. of these papers. And compare these methods.

articleTitle: Designing Sustainable Healthcare Service Based on Dynamic Extraction of Requirements Hidden from User's Language
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to extract hidden healthcare requirements from users as a trial to design a new smart healthcare service. We took providing essential oils as one example of healthcare services as the oils are one of alternative medicines and well known having market potential. As the research method, we collected freely described words by users and analyzed using text mining. Features of recognitions such as perceptions about the purpose, location and time of health care for users were extracted. Furthermore, gender gaps in the recognitions were found. Based on the analysis results, several concepts for designing a new service were derived. Implementing the process of this research on the Internet and accumulating information by users enables various concepts related to healthcare to be dynamically designed. This smart healthcare service is expected to provide a sustainable service that is suitable to the situation of users and companies in the changing environment.

articleTitle: An Efficiency Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Medical Equipment for Civil Use
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The purpose of this project is to research on the connection of data changes between back and forth analyses, as well as an establishment of an objective and precise evaluation mode after using this medical equipment with artificial intelligence. Hence, suppose that meridians and organs in human bodies are the integral unity. Through the method of the energy adjustment, utilizing the detective process of A.I. Medical equipment aside from integrating the variation and verification of the Conscious Energy can be inspected and assisted during the situation of subject's working and learning as a basis and auxiliary therapy to analyze how civil physical and mental balance works. The value in this research is to promote a stable balance between the subject's body and mind in addition to work safety with an eye to prove that integration of human body and mind is the structure of coherence. Therefore, this research can be regarded as the foundation of integration theory on the subject's body and mind with a view to make sure one's physical and mental balance state.

articleTitle: Research on the Circuit Layout of High-Definition Multimedia Interface of Notebook Computer against the Interference of Radiation Noise
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This paper studies the effects of HDMI 1.4's EMI noise interference strategy, PCB layout analysis and testing, near-field intensity radiation distribution, and comparison between the improved HDMI layout and the original layout EMI distribution.[1]–[6]. In this study, the intensity distribution of the electromagnetic noise field was analyzed using a near-field electromagnetic induction instrument. After actual verification, the revised PCB layout conforms to the standard. At the same time, it can meet the EMI requirements of most notebook HDMI related products.

articleTitle: A Kind of Cognitive Training Device for Autistic Children
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: With the development of society, the problem of autistic children has attracted increasing attention, more technologies have been applied to the treatment of autism. However, there is no effective treatment method yet. Autistic children can only implement comprehensive rehabilitation through multiple interventions. In order to improve the effect of rehabilitation training for autistic children, we designed a training device to assist autistic children's color cognition according to the color cognition characteristics of autistic children. The device combines the acousto-optic control technology and uses LED to display color, graphics and other cognitive training information, recognizes the children's utterances through automatic speech recognition technology, and then controls the LED and speaker to display interrelated light and music through the control system in order to stimulate the sensory system of the autistic children. This will increase children's interest in learning, achieve the purpose of fun training, and enhance the effect of training.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Interactive System of Medical Equipment and Sickbed
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent interactive system of medical equipment and sickbed is proposed. Medical equipment and sickbed can interact with each other through visible light communication with LED lights in the same space. It helps patients to remote control, query diagnosis and treatment results in real time. It also significantly improves diagnosis and treatment experience and hospital operation efficiency. In this system, OFDM and MIMO technology are introduced for high-speed transmission and high-frequency spectrum utilization. In order to solve the problem of intercode interference, the system uses the camera to collect multiple light sources and designs the structure of aotu assistive neural network used in the demodulation program, which achieves the better detection of light and anti-interference of ambient light.

articleTitle: Measurement of Effectiveness through Health Management System to Prevent Complications After Hip Surgery
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Side effects occur throughout the whole body including ulcer, pneumonia, and hematocardial thrombosis with hip fractures. Therefore, this study measures the effectiveness through health management system to prevent complications after a hip surgery. The experimental and the control group of 83 patients each participated in this study. Health practice for preventing complications was measured by t-test between the two groups with and without intervention of health management system. The results of this study showed 1) muscle strength after a hip surgery has been strengthened after management (t=-4.15, p<; .01) and 2) complications decreased significantly by 30-40% after training compared to pre-health management (t=-8.13, p<; .01). Therefore, the health management system has proven to be effective in reducing complications after a hip joint surgery. The system provided the establishment of a systematic database through clinical trials and useful methods.

articleTitle: Interaction Design for Smart Healthcare System Considering Older Adults' Healthy and Wellbeing Lifestyles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: It is the ultimate value of smart healthcare systems to promote older adults' healthy aging and improve their wellbeing in their later years. Addressing differences in lifestyle segmentation in older adults, three different types were selected in this research: the active type, the peaceful type and the passive type. On top of that, focus groups with older adults' participation was adapted to propose the strategies of interaction design suitable for the three types based on their respective group characteristics, thus enhancing the level of individualization and adaptation of smart healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Development of an Assistive Device via Smart Glasses
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: This study used smart glasses as the carrier to develop three applications aimed at the elderly. Taiwan entered an elderly society in 2018, with the proportion of the elderly population exceeding 14%. It is estimated that the elderly population will exceed 20% in 2026, and Taiwan will enter an ultra-elderly society. To improve the quality of life of the elderly and attach importance to the health care of the elderly, more and more scientific and technological products are used to improve the life and consumption patterns of the elderly, thereby promoting the popularization of smart wearable devices and sensing technologies. In view of the purpose, this research develops related functional applications with smart glasses. First, the memory recall mechanism is carried out based on face recognition. When the user uses the function, an embedded camera in glasses is turned on to capture the target personnel. Afterwards, a KNN (K Nearest Neighbor) machine learning approach is applied to identify the target, and the personal data is performed in the glasses through searching on the developed cloud database. Besides, the user can add, delete and modify the personal data through the computer, which the entrance is carried out by scanning the two-dimension code shown in the computer program with glasses for security purpose. Secondly, the image enhancement function shows that the captured texts can be expanded and enlarged in the projection monitor of glasses. Finally, the construction of voice commands is performed through the microphone within the suite of smart glasses. The results show that the accuracy rate of KNN face recognition is 93.3%, which can be applied to general life situations.

articleTitle: Changing Energy Efficiency in Energy-Deficient Shandong, China
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: Shandong is a highly developed and energy-deficient province in the east of China. The energy self-sufficiency ratio had decreased from 78.54% in 2000 to 33.32% in 2016. However, Shandong's energy efficiency has not received researcher's attention. Therefore, this study aims to explore the major forces in changing energy efficiency of Shandong utilizing the revised Divisia Index Model between 2001 and 2015. The results of this research show that: Firstly, energy-saving policies are the major factors for the reduction of Shandong's energy intensity, especially for the secondary sector. Secondly, improving energy efficiency has always been the driving force for decreasing energy intensity in Shandong from 2001 to 2015. Finally, the effect of industrial structure has gradually increased since 2006 and its contribution towards reducing energy intensity has been increasing.

articleTitle: Objective Resource Beamforming in Broadband SWIPT System by Evolution Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 2nd Eurasia Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare and Sustainability (ECBIOS)
abstract: The evolutionary algorithm beamforming technology of multi-user resource allocation in wireless information and power transmission (SWIPT) system is studied. In large-capacity broadband communication systems, there are many users with wearable devices. The transmitter provides wireless information and power to a specific receiver at the same time, while other receivers can obtain energy from the radio frequency when idle. Under the constraint of bit error rate (BER), by adjusting the length of the feed line of the transmitting antenna and the excitation current, the energy capture efficiency is maximized. Asynchronous particle swarm optimization (APSO) and adaptive dynamic differential evolution algorithm (SADDE) are used to synthesize the optimal radiation pattern. Both APSO and SADDE can form a good pattern to receive energy. However, APSO has a faster convergence rate than SADDE.
